steps.code:
# Compute most common genre per playlist and update titles
from collections import Counter

access_token = login_result['access_token']

for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # most_common returns list of (genre, count) sorted by count desc, then by insertion order? Actually Counter.most_common returns in order of count, ties broken by insertion order (first seen). We'll take the first.
    most_common_genre = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common_genre}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl['playlist_id']}: '{pl['title']}' -> '{new_title}'")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
    print(result)
